review_notes: Reviewed all 93 lines of SphereVolume.lean and the imported sphere-cone definitions and join simp lemmas. The only justified interface improvement I found is a controlled simp rule for evaluating sphereCone on joined coordinates; I found no competing rewrite direction or credible cycle.

findings.problem: The common coordinate expression sphereCone p (join (r,y)) has no dedicated simp rule, so these proofs must unfold sphereCone and separately simplify join_zero and drop_join. The same expansion is repeated in sphereCone_image. This exposes implementation details at each use instead of providing the canonical coordinate form.
findings.proposed_change: Add a lemma such as `@[simp] lemma sphereCone_join (p : Sphere) (r : ℝ) (y : E2) : sphereCone p (join (r,y)) = r • sphereParam p y := rfl`. Use it in place of the explicit unfolding in these proofs where applicable.
findings.benefit: The expression rewrites directly to its coordinate normal form without unfolding sphereCone globally. The rule reduces a joined input to a scalar multiple and does not introduce a reverse rewrite; it also remains valid for the degenerate case r = 0.

evidence.excerpt: def sphereCone (p : Sphere) (z : E3) : E3 := (z 0) • sphereParam p (dropPlane z)
@[simp] lemma drop_join (z : ℝ × E2) : dropPlane (join z) = z.2 := by ext i; rfl
